There's a video player attached to Kylar's computer via arcane means. It could play the tape you found at the temple, but you'll need Kylar around to operate it.
"Kylar," you say. <<His>> eyes open at once.
"I'm sorry to wake you. Can you play this video?"
"Sorry to wake you. Can you play this video for me?"
Kylar nods, throws off the covers, and stumbles to <<his>> computer. <<He>> fiddles with the jungle of cables, connecting and reconnecting, then slots the tape into the older player.
"Kylar," you say. <<He>> swivels on <<his>> chair to face you.
"I have a video tape here. If it's no trouble, could you play it for me?"
"Could you play this video tape for me?"

Kylar nods, and almost drops the tape as <<he>> takes it. <<He>> needs your help to lift one of the monitors, then <<he>> reaches towards the back of <<his>> desk to fiddle with the jungle of cables, connecting and reconnecting. <<He>> leans to the side, and slots the tape into the old player.
The video comes to life. It shows a stage from the point of view of someone in a packed audience. You recognise it as the town hall.
Kylar looks uneasy, then horrified as several small figures walk onto the stage. One looks particularly nervous. It's a younger Kylar. <> costume is nice, but <> hair is dishevelled, and <> eyes red.
The Kylar sat beside you sways. <> sways as if about to faint, then half falls, half stumbles from <> chair. <> scrambles beneath <> bedsheet.
"Please stay," you say. "I know you don't want to, but it would mean a lot if you watched with me."
"Don't be a wuss," you say. "It's just a video."
"I know you don't want to," you say. "But please stay and watch with me."
You hear a small weep, then Kylar emerges from beneath the covers, and returns to <<his>> chair, and fixes <<his>> eyes on the screen.

Back in the video, Kylar lines up with the other figures. They begin speaking rehearsed lines in turn, but something distracts them. You hear murmuring from the front of the audience. One of the figures on stage holds their nose.

Back in the video, Kylar lines up with the other figures. They begin speaking rehearsed lines in turn, but something distracts them. You hear murmuring from the front of the audience. One of the figures on stage holds their nose.
It's Kylar's turn to speak. <<His>> voice quivers, full of stops and starts.
"It's Kylar," shouts a young voice from off-camera. The murmuring intensifies, accompanied by some laughter, and the figures on either side of Kylar step away. More than a couple hold their nose.
Video-Kylar continues <<his>> lines, but <<he>> quivers, and sniffles, more and more. <<He>> trembles so hard even the grainy film can't hide it.
Beside you, Kylar similarly trembles, tears streaming down <<his>> face. <<He>> releases a strange, keening sound, then hides beneath <<his>> bedsheets again.
You rest a hand on Kylar, and speak soothing words, but <<hes>> trapped in a nightmare of <<his>> own.
You turn back to the tape.

The tape ends, rewinds, and repeats. Kylar and the others walk onto the stage, but this time you notice something else. A hand with a black sleeve emerges from the curtain alongside Kylar. It reaches into <<his>> pocket, then withdraws.
You replay the tape again, in case you imagined it. You did not. You watch the rest of the tape. Perhaps there's something else you missed.

After several more rewinds, you notice a figure moving amongst the audience, wearing black, like certain members of the temple. They lean close to people in the audience, whispering in their ear before moving on.
Some don't respond. Others smirk, or frown. The figure leaves frame right after the voice calls Kylar by name.

You feel their presence before you hear them. Kylar's parents stand behind you, watching the screen. They turn towards Kylar, and approach <<his>> shuddering form. Their clawed fingers reach for <<him>>, but hesitate just shy of touching, as if afraid to. Kylar stirs, and they dart from the room without a sound.
Kylar's face appears beneath the covers, red eyes resting on you. <<He>> holds out a hand.
<<link [[Pull <<him>> into a hug|Manor Tape Hug]]>><<npcincr Kylar love 3>><</link>><<gglove>>
You take Kylar's hand. <<He>> squeezes it so tight it starts to feel numb, <<his>> gaze locked with yours as if looking away would end the world.
<<link [[Ask about what you just saw|Manor Tape Ask 2]]>><</link>>
You take Kylar's hand, only to pull <<him>> into a hug. <<Hes>> still trembling. Your chest is soon soaked in <<his>> tears.
<<link [[Ask about what you just saw|Manor Tape Ask 2]]>><</link>>
You remain motionless. Kylar withdraws <<his>> hand, and hides <<his>> face again. "Sorry sorry sorry," <<he>> says. "Sorry."
<<link [[Ask about what you just saw|Manor Tape Ask 2]]>><</link>>
"I hope I'm not prying," you say. "But can you tell me about that video?"
"What was that I just witnessed? Looked like it happened a while ago."
"What happened in the video?" you ask.
Kylar opens <<his>> mouth to speak, but then tenses, tears streaming. "I'm sorry," <<he>> manages.
You remain silent. Kylar sits back, looking even smaller than usual.
You stay with Kylar a while. <<He>> leans into you, clinging as if the wind threatened to carry you away. You hold <<him>> until <<his>> shuddering subsides.

"Thank you," <<he>> says after a while, pulling away and regarding you with worshipful eyes. Then, as if having spent every ounce of <<his>> energy, <<he>> collapses into a nap. You tuck <<him>> into bed, and leave the room.
Outside, you feel a presence. You look left and right, but see nothing. Then you look up. Two pairs of eyes bore into you. Then vanish.
